description_en: Retrieves a list of AI agent voiceprints
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-ai-agent-voiceprints --voiceprint-id vp_1699123456_8527 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --registration-mode Explicit --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAIAgentVoiceprints

parameters.help_en: The unique voiceprint ID. If specified, this operation returns the details of a single voiceprint. If omitted, it returns a paginated list of all voiceprints under your account
parameters.help_zh: 声纹识别的唯一身份ID。选填。不填写则罗列账号下的声纹id，填写则展示填写的声纹id
parameters.name: voiceprint_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Must be 1 or greater
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The registration mode for the voiceprint. The default value is `Explicit`
parameters.help_zh: 声纹注册模式。 默认值：Explicit
parameters.name: registration_mode
